name: Mamiya Kyouichi
source: The youngest son of the Mamiya Family, Kyouichi is very similar to Marisa in personality: being both rude and temperamental. He prefers to just playing games or spending time alone rather than family affair in general. [spoiler]Since Mitarai's arrival, Kyouichi has been losing interest in Mikako. He may turn Mitarai into his sex slave should she fails to the trap set by his mother.[/spoiler]
